summary: This Form 6-K reports an open-market share repurchase program by Prudential plc, conducted through JP Morgan Securities. Between 11-15 May 2026, the company bought back ~1,276k ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of approximately 11.42 GBP per share, all under a buyback authority approved at the 2025 AGM and an arrangement entered in January 2026. Repurchased shares are to be cancelled, lowering share count. Over the program's duration, 30,244,552 shares have been bought. This is a routine capital return via on-market purchases, not a tender. Watch for further buyback pace and potential accretion impact.
